issueSnapshots.title: Start and test the frontend independently of backend services
issueSnapshots.workflow_status: in_progress — Owner-authorized mock-backed frontend implementation and verification are underway. Current work remains local/uncommitted; acceptance, delivery and closure are pending. Production-only prerequisites and named unresolved slices remain separate.
issueSnapshots.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] AC-01: Documented clean local startup and production build succeed in explicit mock mode without starting backend/database services or supplying production credentials.
- [ ] AC-02: Meaningful unit/component and browser smoke checks run from documented commands; a broken mount/behavior is demonstrably detected.
- [ ] AC-03: Test storage and scenario control are isolated and reset reproducibly without touching unrelated user/browser data.
- [ ] AC-04: An unavailable real adapter produces a clear configuration failure rather than silent mock fallback or production calls.

issueSnapshots.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] AC-01: One consumer-facing API supports all active logical responsibilities and interchangeable adapter construction without UI/store transport branching.
- [ ] AC-02: Public data/errors preserve ownership, selected-section and version/operation truth; unknown results are not success, invalid credentials or permission to duplicate a mutation.

issueSnapshots.title: Keep mock credits, reservations and entitlements coherent and exactly once
issueSnapshots.workflow_status: in_progress — Owner-authorized mock-backed frontend implementation and verification are underway. Current work remains local/uncommitted; acceptance, delivery and closure are pending. Production-only prerequisites and named unresolved slices remain separate.
issueSnapshots.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] AC-01: Eligible grant, verified purchase fulfillment, capacity upgrade and each reservation/settlement/return are applied once under duplicate/reload/lost-response scenarios; ineligible returning identities receive no repeated grant.
- [ ] AC-02: Concurrent quotes/processing/purchases observe coherent available/reserved/purchased-remainder/history/capacity revisions and cannot overspend through stale UI.
- [ ] AC-03: Selected-duration ceil boundaries are correct; system preparation failure releases rather than charges, and synthetic cancellation outcome follows only its current explicitly confirmed quote.
- [ ] AC-04: Pending purchase is never posted as success, reservations never masquerade as final charges and deleting a project/account never fabricates a refund.
issueSnapshots.completion_record: Not executed; no financial or production verification claimed.

issueSnapshots.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] AC-01: Reload restores committed account/project/operation facts and associated fixture/media references; uncommitted bytes are not advertised as durable.
- [ ] AC-02: Isolation and revision/operation reconciliation prevent cross-account leakage, duplicate effects, stale-event resurrection and contradictory observers.
- [ ] AC-03: Reset/scenario selection is reproducible and confined to mock/test storage; arbitrary production backend/provider calls cannot occur.
- [ ] AC-04: Failure/quota/partial-write scenarios preserve prior committed records and expose recoverable honest errors; mock limitations are visible in evidence.
